properties.name: MEASURED 2026-10-02 (0.77.0), limitation 4 CONFIRMED and its mechanism corrected. `--call` ACCEPTS `--export-to FILE`, writes, exits 0 and never writes FILE, with no warning. It is not that the call "exits first" before a debounced export: the door never reads the flag
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), triage agent A, on limitation 4 of art:vscode-call-door-field-report-2026-10-02 ("--export-to write-through only starts in a long-lived server; --call exits first"), and on the brief's question whether --call accepts --export-to at all.

① OBSERVED: `reflow2-mcp --graph-path l4/g --export-to l4/design.json --call add_requirement --args '{…}'` → exit 0, the requirement's receipt on stdout, stderr empty at RUST_LOG=error. l4/design.json does NOT exist afterwards. At RUST_LOG=info the log shows the store opening and the in-process handshake, and no export line. Log: /home/ajs7/.claude/jobs/fa666a94/tmp/triage-A/measure.log (L4-*).

② PRECEDENT: dec:idea-a-writing-call-exports-afterwards (settled) and this requirement (step 2 of the plan) already hold the remedy. The contrast is cap:a-design-can-be-served-ephemerally: --ephemeral REFUSES every flag that contradicts it. --call refuses none.

③/④ CANDIDATES: (a) the write-through starts but the process exits before its debounce fires (the reporter's reading); (b) the door never starts it; (c) a write-through refusal (a tamper guard) was swallowed.
(b) holds. call_one_tool has no reference to export_to, and start_auto_export is called only in the ephemeral, --serve-shared and single-design serving branches. So (a) and (c) never get the chance to happen. A first version that did start it would ALSO meet (a): AutoExport is a spawned, debounced task, and call_over_pipe tears down the server at once. That is why the requirement's MUST needs a synchronous export after the reply, not the write-through task.

⑥ CLASS: the same as fact:root-cause-one-shot-modes-return-before-the-pointer-check-and-opening-a-store-creates-it-2026-10-02 and the --remote/--shared drops in fact:root-cause-the-door-opens-the-store-itself-and-never-reads-the-shared-servers-rendezvous-2026-10-02. Which flags count is decided by which early return main() takes, and the one-shot branches declare no conflicts. Today an agent or instructions file that adds `--export-to` believing it helps gets a silent no-op. The planned fix should either honour the flag or refuse it by name. That choice belongs to req:a-writing-call-keeps-the-committed-export-current, which says the path comes from the project's configuration.
